pd-v0.1.0.description:
The first release of Perfect Dark Archipelago using the PC port. Only supports Windows for now.

Instructions on how to use this: [Setup guide](https://github.com/ajeloom/Perfect-Dark-PC-AP/blob/main/worlds/perfect_dark/docs/setup_en.md).

This is a separate build from the original PC port. If you find any issues, please report them on our [issues page](https://github.com/ajeloom/Perfect-Dark-PC-AP/issues).

## Features
- Two goals to choose from: 
  - Complete Skedar Ruins
  - Collect Mission Stars
- Weapon Progression
- Challenge checks
- Firing Range checks
- Device Training checks
- Holotraining checks
- Death Link
- Random player characters
- Random music
pd-v0.1.0.title: Perfect Dark (PC) AP v0.1.0

pd-v0.2.0.description:
This new release adds the rest of the difficulties, cheats, and other requested features. Only supports Windows for now.

Instructions on how to use this: [Setup guide](https://github.com/ajeloom/Perfect-Dark-PC-AP/blob/main/worlds/perfect_dark/docs/setup_en.md).

This is a separate build from the original PC port. If you find any issues, please report them on our [issues page](https://github.com/ajeloom/Perfect-Dark-PC-AP/issues).

This update also includes a new client build that doesn't work with older versions of the apworld. Please update if you are on an older build of the client.

## New Features
- Agent and Special Agent checks
- Mission logic difficulties
- Unlock cheat checks
- Cheats added to the itempool
  - Use cheats to help you complete checks if you want
- Master Key option
  - Combines key cards into one item for some missions
- Can toggle displaying location name in game
## Changes
- Tweaked Weapon Progression order
- Device training can now be done in any order
- Renamed some locations
- Co-operative is re-enabled
- Perfect Dark mode is re-enabled
  - Can do Perfect Agent checks and unlock cheat checks
  - Automatically unlocked if Perfect Agent is available
- Removed cheat unlock restriction when using cheats or playing Perfect Dark mode
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed issue with incorrect location names displaying
pd-v0.2.0.title: Perfect Dark (PC) AP v0.2.0

pd-v0.3.0.description:
This new release adds more goals, two new weapon progression options, additional challenge options, and new randomization options. Currently, only Windows is supported.

Instructions on how to use this: [Setup guide](https://github.com/ajeloom/Perfect-Dark-PC-AP/blob/main/worlds/perfect_dark/docs/setup_en.md).

This is a separate build from the original PC port. If you find any issues, please report them on our [issues page](https://github.com/ajeloom/Perfect-Dark-PC-AP/issues).

This update also includes a new client build that doesn't work with older versions of the apworld. Please update if you are on an older build of the client.

## New Features
- Two New Goals
  - Complete Challenges
  - Complete Missions and Challenges
- Skedar Ruins Requirements
  - A new option for Skedar Ruins goal that sets how Skedar Ruins is unlocked.
  - Four options:
    - Item
    - Collect Mission Stars
    - Collect Challenge Stars
    - Collect Both Mission and Challenge Stars
- Two New Weapon Progression Options
  - All Guns
    - Each unlocked weapon will be in your inventory at the start of a mission.
  - Progressive Types
    - Splits the Progressive Weapon into five types: Pistol, SMG, Rifle, Explosive, and Other.
- Challenge Logic
  - Three difficulties:
    - Strict
    - Normal
    - Hard
- Excluded Challenges option
  - You can set which challenges will not send a check.
- Shorter Challenges option
  - Shortens the time limit and score limit for every challenge.
- Two New Random Options
  - Random Enemy Weapons: Randomizes every enemy's weapon.
  - Random Buddy Weapons: Randomizes the co-op buddy's weapon.
  - Both can be toggled in-game from the Archipelago menu.

## Changes
- Weapons and devices are now sent to your inventory while you are in a mission that they appear in.
- Improved the in-game Archipelago menu.
  - Gameplay Options in the Archipelago menu is now renamed to YAML Settings and shows more settings.
  - New options added are separated into two menus: Random Options and Other Options.
- For Progressive One Gun, Laptop Gun is given alongside the Mines, Grenade, or N-Bomb to make it more fair.

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed issue where using multiple weights on an option in the YAML would cause mismatch logic on Universal Tracker.
- Fixed issue where you can still get a DeathLink even with the Invincible cheat enabled.
pd-v0.3.0.title: Perfect Dark (PC) AP v0.3.0

pd-v0.3.1.description:
This new release is a small update that fixes some problems found in the last version. Currently, only Windows is supported.

Instructions on how to use this: [Setup guide](https://github.com/ajeloom/Perfect-Dark-PC-AP/blob/main/worlds/perfect_dark/docs/setup_en.md).

This is a separate build from the original PC port. If you find any issues, please report them on our [issues page](https://github.com/ajeloom/Perfect-Dark-PC-AP/issues).

This update includes a new client build and a new apworld. Please update both for this to work correctly.

## Changelog
- You get your weapons back in Progressive Types and Progressive Weapon on Air Base after doing the "Subvert security monitoring system" objective.
- Adjusted the amount of ammo given in Progressive Types and All Guns, so you can pick up weapons without having to use some ammo first.
- Added YAML option to include cheats in the item pool.
- Cheats can now be unlocked the normal way even if unlock cheats check is on or off.
- Fixed what items it creates for certain options. 
  - Allows the Challenge goal or the Skedar Ruins goal with the Challenge Star requirement to be completed without playing any missions.
- Added more info to some of the option descriptions in the YAML.
- Removed debug text from the console.
pd-v0.3.1.title: Perfect Dark (PC) AP v0.3.1

pd-v0.3.2.description:
This new release fixes more problems found in the last build. Currently, only Windows is supported.

This update includes a new client build and a new apworld. Please update both for this to work correctly.

## Changelog
- You now receive max ammo for some of the explosives and knives in Progressive Types and All Guns.
- Fixed an issue where you couldn't pick up dropped weapons in Progressive Types.
- Fixed an issue where you wouldn't get the final progressive weapon if you have more progressive weapons than you can normally get.
- Fixed an issue where Skedar Ruins wouldn't unlock when all the difficulty options are disabled.
- Fixed an issue where you were missing the Skedar Ruins location checks when all the difficulty options are disabled.
- Key cards are now only added to the item pool if at least one difficulty is enabled.
- Adjusted logic on Air Base for Progressive Types.
- Fixed an issue where certain devices required for some challenges were not in the item pool when device training and all difficulty options were disabled.
- Added a command to the console to check the client's version.
- You now don't need to specify `ws://` or `wss://` before `localhost` when connecting to your locally hosted game. It automatically uses `ws://`.
pd-v0.3.2.title: Perfect Dark (PC) AP v0.3.2

pd-v0.4.0.description:
This new release adds a new NPC option, separated cheat options, and changes to allow you to use the same save file for every run. Currently, only Windows is supported.

Instructions on how to use this: [Setup guide](https://github.com/ajeloom/Perfect-Dark-PC-AP/blob/main/worlds/perfect_dark/docs/setup_en.md).

This is a separate build from the original PC port. If you find any issues, please report them on our [issues page](https://github.com/ajeloom/Perfect-Dark-PC-AP/issues).

This update also includes a new client build that doesn't work with older versions of the apworld. Please update if you are on an older build of the client.

## New Features
- NPC option
  - Important characters must be unlocked to complete certain missions and objectives.
- Added an option to place Mission Stars and Challenge Stars at any location.
- Added a menu to view unlocked weapons near the mission overview and briefing.
- Added a `/reconnect` command to the console.
## Changes
- Cheat unlocks are now separated into three options:
  - Completion Cheat Unlocks
  - Timed Cheat Unlocks
  - Weapon Cheat Unlocks
- The following changes were made to allow you to use the same save file:
  - Mission stars and challenge stars are colored if their locations are completed.
  - Firing range medals do not use saved scores to show the completed ones unless weapon training is disabled.
  - Co-op mission stars are now colored based on completed locations like in Solo.
- You can now sacrifice any weapon in Skedar Ruins.
- You cannot unlock cheats the normal way if cheats are in the item pool.
- If cheats are not in the item pool, then you have to unlock them or use a save file that has them unlocked already in order to use them.
- In Progressive Types, you only swap to the weapon sent to you if you are holding the weapon type that it replaces.
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where it wasn't sending challenge checks if the challenge option was disabled, but you needed challenge stars for the goal.
- Fixed an issue where Laptop Gun was being removed from the inventory in Progressive One Gun during the Mines, Grenade, and N-Bomb.
- Fixed an issue where Elvis could be revived on Agent without the Alien Medpack.
- Fixed an issue where the client would never stop trying to connect if it keeps failing.
pd-v0.4.0.title: Perfect Dark (PC) AP v0.4.0
